target: All machine-resolvable engineering/research-preparation blockers closed; residual evidence-growth blockers reduced to rights/access or evidence that cannot exist without rights-compatible independent source material.

categories.description: EFA project-specific refusal prevents GORILA visual/structured/machine-readable derivative use.
Systematic edition reconciliation cannot proceed until lawful access and intended derivative use are established.
2D+/3D/object-level datasets cannot be ingested without compatible permission.
Disputed physical readings cannot be independently adjudicated from the existing single-source derivative. This is not an unfinished software task.
Prospective scoring remains sealed until an independent, admissible input/gold basis exists. No engineering task may substitute for independence.
Browser, API, context extraction, loss-aware export, scholarship/geospatial validators, metrology and sequence-analysis baselines exist and are CI-routed.
Pre-expert handoff, review queues, provenance/rights boundaries and capability status are documented.

rule: Do not call a human-evidence dependency an engineering blocker. Do not call rights-only until every remaining MACHINE_RESOLVABLE item is COMPLETE or explicitly optional depth that cannot change evidence admissibility.
